description: Local 'care needed' notifications gated by a settings toggle. Extend the settings store with a backward-compatible notificationsEnabled boolean (default false), add a toggle to SettingsPanel, request Notification permission ONLY from the toggle's click/change handler (user gesture, never on load), and when enabled + permission granted schedule a LOCAL notification (setTimeout while the page is alive, no push server/VAPID) for when hunger is PROJECTED to reach HUNGRY_CAUTION_LEVEL. Add a PURE, unit-tested projection helper for the timing math. Everything is feature-detected and gracefully degrades when notifications are off, denied, or unsupported. JA/EN parity for all new strings. Depends on FEAT-001 (SW/PWA foundation).
steps: In packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts, extend the Settings interface with `notificationsEnabled: boolean` and add it to DEFAULT_SETTINGS as `false` (default OFF). Update parseSettings to coerce it: `notificationsEnabled: typeof parsed.notificationsEnabled === 'boolean' ? parsed.notificationsEnabled : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.notificationsEnabled`. Keep every EXISTING key byte-identical and backward compatible (a stored blob without the key parses to false, no throw).

In packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts, add a PURE, DOM/React-free helper for the hunger-to-caution projection, mirroring the fullnessPercent/isHungerCaution/dayStamp style (Number.isFinite guards, uses shared MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL / HUNGRY_CAUTION_LEVEL / and a tick-rate constant). Signature suggestion: `msUntilHungerCaution({ hungryLevel, lastUpdatedAt, isSleeping }, now, tickMs = HUNGER_TICK_MS): number | null` returning ms-from-now until hungryLevel would reach HUNGRY_CAUTION_LEVEL. Behavior: if isSleeping -> null (hunger does not rise while sleeping, per applyTimePassage); if hungryLevel >= HUNGRY_CAUTION_LEVEL -> 0 (already at/over caution); otherwise levels remaining = HUNGRY_CAUTION_LEVEL - hungryLevel, and the monster already has (now - lastUpdatedAt) of accumulated elapsed time toward the next tick, so compute target = lastUpdatedAt + levelsRemaining*tickMs and return Math.max(0, target - now); guard non-finite inputs to null. Export the tick-rate constant used (import TICK value conceptually = 60_000; since shared game.ts TICK_MS is not exported, define a local `export const HUNGER_TICK_MS = 60_000` with a comment pointing at shared game.ts TICK_MS as the source of truth, and add a note to keep them in sync). Also consider a thin companion `hungerCautionTargetTimestamp(...)` returning an absolute timestamp (now + ms) or null, if useful for scheduling — optional.

In packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts, add unit tests for the extended parseSettings (missing notificationsEnabled defaults to false; explicit true/false preserved; non-boolean coerced to false; existing fields still parsed) and for msUntilHungerCaution: already-at-caution (hungryLevel = HUNGRY_CAUTION_LEVEL or above) -> 0; N levels away with lastUpdatedAt === now -> N*HUNGER_TICK_MS; partial elapsed since lastUpdatedAt reduces the remaining time; sleeping -> null; non-finite hungryLevel/lastUpdatedAt -> null; capped/high hungryLevel handled. Import the new symbols at the top of the file. Keep the file DOM/React-free.

In packages/frontend/src/components/SettingsPanel.tsx, add a notifications on/off checkbox row following the existing settings-row pattern (id 'settings-notifications', labelled by t('settings.notifications')). Its onChange must call a handler that (a) when turning ON, requests permission via a user-gesture-safe callback passed from the parent (so the actual Notification.requestPermission() runs inside this click/change handler), and (b) calls onChange({...settings, notificationsEnabled: checked}). To keep the gesture requirement explicit and testable-by-reading, add an optional prop like `onToggleNotifications?: (enabled: boolean) => void` that the parent wires to the permission request, OR request permission inline within the change handler guarded by feature detection ('Notification' in window). Whichever approach: the permission request MUST originate from this user interaction, NEVER on mount/load. If Notification is unsupported, the toggle still flips the stored setting but no permission prompt occurs (graceful).

In packages/frontend/src/App.tsx, wire the notifications feature end-to-end: (a) pass the current settings (now including notificationsEnabled) to SettingsPanel and handle the gesture-gated permission request — when the user enables notifications, call Notification.requestPermission() from within the user-event handler (feature-detected: only if typeof Notification !== 'undefined'); store the resulting setting via updateSettings regardless. (b) Add a guarded effect that, when settings.notificationsEnabled is true AND Notification is supported AND Notification.permission === 'granted' AND game.monster is present, computes msUntilHungerCaution from the live monster (hungryLevel, lastUpdatedAt, isSleeping) and schedules a setTimeout to fire a local notification (new Notification(title, { body, icon })) at that time; title/body come from new i18n keys. Clear/reschedule the timeout whenever the monster state, the setting, or permission changes (cleanup in the effect's return). If the projection is null (sleeping/unsupported) or <=0 handling: if already at/over caution (0) you may notify shortly/skip to avoid spamming — choose a sensible, documented behavior (e.g. do not fire immediately on mount for an already-hungry monster; only fire on the projected future transition). (c) Everything guarded so notifications OFF / denied / unsupported leaves the game fully functional with no errors and no blocked UI.

In packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts, add new keys to BOTH JA_MESSAGES and EN_MESSAGES (keep JA existing keys byte-identical): `settings.notifications` (JA e.g. '通知', EN 'Notifications'), optionally `settings.notificationsHint`, and the notification copy e.g. `notify.hungryTitle` (JA 'おなかがすいてきたよ', EN 'Getting hungry'), `notify.hungryBody` (JA e.g. 'そろそろごはんの時間かも。会いに来てね！', EN e.g. "It's almost mealtime. Come check in!"). Use the monster name if easy via a {name} placeholder + replace, mirroring settings.volumeValue's {percent} pattern; otherwise keep copy generic. Ensure EN_MESSAGES stays a complete Record<MessageKey,string> (compile-enforced).

Update README.md (EN) and README.ja.md (JA) with a short PWA + notifications section: that the app is installable (Add to Home Screen) via manifest + service worker, the SW caching strategy summary and why it updates correctly under CloudFront (network-first HTML, hashed assets stale-while-revalidate, config.json never cached), that notification permission is only requested from a user gesture (the settings toggle, default OFF) and the game works normally without it, and that notifications are LOCAL (fire only while a tab/SW is alive; no push server). Keep JA and EN in parity.

Confirm graceful degradation by reading the code paths: Notification/serviceWorker feature-detected everywhere; no top-level or on-mount permission request; toggling OFF clears any scheduled timeout; denied/unsupported paths do not throw.
acceptance_criteria: Settings interface + DEFAULT_SETTINGS include notificationsEnabled (default false); parseSettings is backward-compatible (blob missing the key -> false, no throw) and all existing keys/behavior are byte-identical.

A pure helper (e.g. msUntilHungerCaution) exists in ui-helpers.ts with Number.isFinite guards and uses shared HUNGRY_CAUTION_LEVEL / MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL + a documented HUNGER_TICK_MS=60_000; it returns 0 when already at/over caution, N*tick when N levels away with lastUpdatedAt===now, a reduced value for partial elapsed time, and null when sleeping or inputs non-finite.
game-ui.test.ts has new passing tests covering the projection helper edge cases AND the extended parseSettings; frontend test count rises above the 135 baseline.

SettingsPanel shows a notifications toggle (default reflects stored false); permission is requested ONLY from the toggle's user-gesture handler, never on load; feature-detected so unsupported browsers do not throw.

App schedules a LOCAL setTimeout notification for the projected caution time only when enabled + supported + permission granted + monster present, and reschedules/clears on state/setting/permission change; with notifications OFF/denied/unsupported the game runs normally with no errors.

New i18n keys exist in BOTH JA and EN (EN remains a complete Record<MessageKey,string>); existing JA keys unchanged. README.md + README.ja.md document the PWA + notification behavior and the CloudFront-safe SW caching.
No new runtime dependency; `npm run build`, `npm test`, and `npm test -w @ddm/frontend` all pass.
verification: Run `npm test -w @ddm/frontend` and confirm the new projection + parseSettings tests pass and total exceeds 135.
Run `npm test` (shared) and confirm it stays green (>=152).
Run `npm run build` and confirm tsc + vite build succeed (EN_MESSAGES completeness is compile-enforced).

Read SettingsPanel.tsx + App.tsx and confirm Notification.requestPermission is only called inside a user-event handler (not in an effect that runs on mount), and that all Notification/serviceWorker usage is feature-detected.
findings: Implemented end-to-end. ui-helpers.ts: added notificationsEnabled:boolean to Settings interface + DEFAULT_SETTINGS (default false) + parseSettings coercion (backward-compatible, missing/non-boolean -> false, no throw); added pure HUNGER_TICK_MS=60_000 constant (mirrors shared game.ts TICK_MS, documented to keep in sync), HungerProjectionInput interface, msUntilHungerCaution(input, now, tickMs=HUNGER_TICK_MS) and companion hungerCautionTargetTimestamp. SettingsPanel.tsx: added optional onToggleNotifications prop + 'settings-notifications' checkbox row following the existing settings-row/useCallback pattern; the change handler calls onChange and (only when enabling) onToggleNotifications(true). App.tsx: added handleToggleNotifications (user-gesture-only, feature-detected Notification.requestPermission inside the toggle callback) wired to SettingsPanel; added a guarded effect that schedules a single setTimeout -> new Notification(title,{body,icon}) only when notificationsEnabled && Notification supported && permission==='granted' && monster present, computing msUntilHungerCaution from live monster fields, with clearTimeout cleanup and re-run on setting/permission/monster-hunger/name changes. ALREADY-AT-CAUTION/0/null handling: schedule nothing (only fire on a projected FUTURE transition) so an already-hungry monster never spams on mount; a re-guard inside the timeout re-checks permission. i18n.ts: added JA+EN settings.notifications (通知/Notifications), notify.hungryTitle, notify.hungryBody; EN remains a complete Record<MessageKey,string> (compile-enforced). README.md + README.ja.md: added a PWA & care-notifications section (installable manifest+SW, network-first HTML / stale-while-revalidate hashed assets / config.json never cached under CloudFront, gesture-only permission default-OFF, local setTimeout notifications with no push server). Had to update two PRE-EXISTING parseSettings deepEqual tests (full-shape) to include the new key. VERIFICATION (PATH set to node v22.23.3): npm test -w @ddm/frontend -> 145 pass (up from 135 baseline); npm test (shared) -> 152 pass; npm run build (full tsc + vite + infra) succeeded; dist contains manifest.webmanifest, sw.js, icon.svg. Confirmed Notification.requestPermission is only called inside the user-gesture handleToggleNotifications callback (App.tsx:102) and new Notification only inside the scheduled setTimeout (App.tsx:431); all Notification/serviceWorker usage feature-detected. No new dependencies added.
